PDK.Settings.PartySize.Name: Party size for Epic Bosses
PDK.Settings.PartySize.Hint: Epic Bosses get their per-player-character hit points and one Epic Action per player character. 0 counts the characters in the primary party (dnd5e's party sidebar), else the players' own characters, else every player-owned character in the world.
PDK.Settings.Debug.Name: Debug logging
PDK.Settings.Debug.Hint: Write what the automation does to the browser console.
